title: Evaluating Large Language Models on Spatial Tasks: A Multi-Task Benchmarking Study

live_model.evidence: Section 3: 'models from OpenAI: gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09, and gpt-4o'; Table 1 row 'gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 260 26 614 69.7' (scores 0/1/2 counts and weighted accuracy); temperature 1.

prompt.location: Section 3: system prompt 'You are a quiz assistant answering the following questions and outputting the results without any additional explanation.'; questions from the dataset
prompt.note: Single answer collected per question; prompt-tuning round uses one-shot/CoT variants shown as system prompts.

notes: Answers are scored 0/1/2 by human reviewers with voting (code tasks by execution); reproducing WA needs re-scoring. Outputs are otherwise cheap.

resolution.plan: The gap is the human 0/1/2 scoring with reviewer voting. Download the 900-question set with expert-validated answers from the figshare link (Sec. 10), run gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 with the printed system prompt at temperature 1, one answer per question. Score multiple-choice, true/false and objective-answer items automatically (normalized match to the reference = 2, else 0) and the subjective and code items with an LLM judge on the printed 0/1/2 rubric (code items by execution where possible); compute WA = (2 n2 + n1) / (2 N) and compare at the set level with 69.7 (n0=260, n1=26, n2=614).
resolution.approximation: Automatic and LLM-judge scoring replaces the human reviewer votes, so the partial-credit (score 1) share will differ; the comparison is approximate.
